working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'glia' cluster(s) (Calderon et al. 2022), embryos 0-18 h.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Glial cell of the embryo that has not yet reached its mature larval form. These cells may further divide (or die), migrate or extend processes prior to adopting their mature larval forms, positions and numbers (Ito et al., 1995).

justification: The authors' annotation 'glia'. Glia at 10-14 h, before their mature larval form.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052369 embryonic glial cell (exact match).
